items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: And Graham, Graham something was his name out of Dallas. Mm-hmm. A fine band.

ctx.x: And Lee was back here, from Chicago.

Oh yeah, yeah, yeah. If he had went to Chicago he would show here, because he was playing right down there. Right next, you see the place, it was just two doors apart, see. One place, you go in, big ballroom way back there, and you go in this place, another nightclub, Foyne and the La Vita, see. And I used to go rest him up. He asked me how long I'm going to be there, I said, oh, I'll be here about an hour, but he said I'll walk around and stretch out a little. Yeah, he was here, most sure he was. That was the…

In 55? Yeah, 55. I must have seen you, you know. Yeah. I used to stay with the Zulus for a while there, but this year I thought I'd change it up, you know. And I caught all of them just about the same, up there. I didn't see the Corner Club.
